name: CERN
summary: CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, has signed on as an official participant of Expo 2027 Belgrade with its own exhibition space — the first time it has joined a World or Specialised Expo in this capacity.

about: CERN — the European Organization for Nuclear Research — has signed an agreement to take part in Expo 2027 Belgrade as an official participant with its own exhibition space, the first time the organization has joined a World or Specialised Expo in this capacity rather than through a national pavilion. The participation was confirmed in late July 2026, with CERN's commissioner for Expo 2027 Belgrade, Ursula Basler, saying the organization is pleased to take part as an official participant for the first time.

CERN's exhibition space is intended to let the millions of visitors expected at Expo 2027 discover the world of modern science in an accessible way and understand why scientific discoveries matter for humanity's future. Organizers tie the contribution directly to the Expo's overall theme, 'Play for Humanity': science, they note, always carries an element of play, curiosity and research that leads to new discoveries and innovations — framed as a natural fit for CERN's presence.
